fact: At an interministerial meeting on 22 June 2026 the Prime Minister said the RNU, updated and extended in early 2026, now lists 996,194 poor or vulnerable households, up from 545,000, and announced a pilot of digital payment of the family security grants before end 2026.
title: PROTECTION SOCIALE : LE GOUVERNEMENT ACCÉLÈRE LA RÉFORME DU REGISTRE NATIONAL UNIQUE ET DES BOURSES FAMILIALES
